prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night just after rain on a 1930s city street: wet cobbles, an iron street lamp, a small bakery with a lit cream shop window full of loaves and a plain sign with no lettering, an ultramarine sky with a small red moon. Seen from high in the bakery's upstairs window, looking steeply down past the dark edge of the window frame in the near foreground: below, two crowds of working people in overalls, aprons, flat caps and factory smocks, each crowd young and old, men and women, Black, white and South Asian: one wears red scarves and waves plain red banners with no writing, the other wears blue scarves and waves plain blue banners with no writing, every face turned towards the other crowd, meeting in a ragged shoving line under the street lamp, red on the left, blue on the right. Two black police cars sit nose to nose at the kerb, headlamps on. The shop window's warm light spills across the cobbles beneath us. Most of the frame in deep shadow; the brightest values are the lamp's pool, the headlamp beams and the shop light on the wet cobbles. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
